`final class OpenTypeMsdfSource`<br/>
**Extends:** [`MsdfSource`](/reference/text/msdfsource/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.impl.msdf.source` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [OpenTypeMsdfSource.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/impl/msdf/source/OpenTypeMsdfSource.java)

Reads a face from a TrueType or OpenType file, generating its MSDF atlas into the cache folder on the first load.

## Description

The atlas covers the codepoints 32 to 563 at 2048 × 2048 pixels.
It is stored in the `msdf` area of the cache folder under a hash of the font and of the generator settings, kept 30 days after its last use, and generated again when the cached file cannot be read.
